title: Topics in communications
description: Advanced topics in communications, such as turbo codes, LDPC codes, multiuser communications, network coding, cross-layer optimization, cognitive radio. Content may vary from year to year to reflect the latest development in the field.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ELEN E6712 ) or ( ELEN E4702 ) or ( ELEN E4703 ) or ELEN E6712 OR ELEN E4702 OR ELEN E4703 ; or equivalent, or instructor's permission.
raw_title_text: ELEN E6713 Topics in communications. 3 points .
